name: Sea of Pirates
summary:
Sea of Pirates is a top-down, open-sea pirate MMO — one living ocean, shared by captains from every corner of the world.

It offers the oldest fantasy on the water: a flag of your own, a crew at your back, and a horizon with no fixed edge. You begin as a nobody on a single-mast sloop and sail into a persistent world that remembers every cannon you fire and every rival you send to the deep. Rise far enough, and the seas learn your name.

This is a world built for the long voyage — seasonal, competitive, and shaped by the players who live in it. No two legends are written the same way. The tide is open; the rest is up to you.
